config.purpose: verify atomic RLOO progress writes and bounded checkpoint storage before the extended budgets

fault_injection: A failed progress-file replacement preserves the previous JSON and optimizer checkpoint. A successful retry commits the new state before removing its predecessor.
retention: Frozen adapters at each fixed budget and complete per-group JSON history remain; keep only the latest resume optimizer/adapter per continuation directory. Original RLOO24 files are unchanged.
scope: Filesystem/resume behavior only; no reward, sampler, gradient, learning rate, seed, budget or model-policy change.
